constraints: If localID is omitted (or an empty string is passed), returns a reference to the datastore matching the local 4D database (or, when opening a remote database on 4D Server, the 4D Server database).
localID must reference a remote datastore previously opened by the current database (host or component) via Open datastore; the local id's scope is the database where it was opened.
The datastore is opened automatically and is available directly through ds; no separate open step is required for the default (no-localID) case.
Returns Null if no datastore matching localID is found.
Objects exposed on the returned cs.DataStore are mapped from the target database following the general ORDA rules.
